label: Traceable carrier
check: Exact data, statistics, source hash and producer can be recovered

label: Internally consistent
check: Carrier, record, evidence sections and root hash agree
limit: Not source truth or analytical suitability

label: Statistics reproduced
check: Numbers match the recorded statistical calculation route

label: Statistics independently verified
check: A separate reference calculation matches declared outputs
limit: Not proof that the chosen test was appropriate

label: Figure reproduced
check: A trusted producer rerun saves a separate matching figure
limit: Requires explicit permission to execute producer code

label: Display verified
check: Bound marks and annotations match their evidence
limit: Unbound decoration is outside the check

label: Source linked
check: Declared transformations reconstruct the plotted table
limit: Not proof that observations were honestly collected

label: Signature valid
check: The signature matches the evidence root and visible binding
limit: Not proof that the signer is trusted

label: Signer trusted
check: The valid signer satisfies an explicit local trust policy

label: Attested
check: A trusted signer approves a deterministic verification report
limit: Not proof that the report was independently rerun now
